tasks.short: Compare production costs for sustainable and nonsustainable designs statistically.

tasks.design: Configure the chosen statistical computations and cost tables in {SPREADSHEET} from actually validated observations. Retain comparison design, cost-data verification, result interpretation and complete written findings; ordinary internal saving is ungated.

tasks.enabler_now: Native statistical functions can compute specified comparisons reproducibly.
tasks.still_hard: Cost allocation, comparability and uncertainty are study decisions.
tasks.human_edge: The technician finds that different production volumes invalidate a raw unit-cost comparison.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native statistical functions can compute defined cost comparisons from validated observations.

assumptions: Provisional computation25 represents actual manual formula/table work. Production owner supplies actual design/batch ids, quantities, currency, cost period and allocation basis; technician obtains and validates them within20. Missing or incomparable costs remain manual, not a free clean dataset.

Method selection25, interpretation20 and real report writing10 remain. No credit for existing formula runtime. No environmental benefit or equal quality is inferred from the sustainable label. No external report send or approval of an ordinary internal save is invented.
unknowns: Which current computations are still manual?
research_questions: Do allocation basis and production volume remain comparable across designs?

incremental.description: Maintain study formulas and test cost-period and allocation exceptions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes25 manual computation points minus1 upkeep=24. Low: inconsistent allocation bases require manual reconciliation and bespoke analysis, leaving only10 compatible summary-table points removable, minus1=9. Study design, source validation, interpretation and full written findings remain.
